brief:
Israeli occupation authorities compelled two Palestinian brothers in Jerusalem's Jabal Mukaber neighborhood to demolish their own homes, Shehab Wire reported. The forced self-demolition displaced two families and resulted in fines totaling hundreds of thousands of shekels.

The demolition orders are part of Israel's systematic policy in occupied East Jerusalem, where Palestinian construction is severely restricted and homes are regularly targeted for destruction.

title: Israeli authorities force Palestinians to demolish homes in East Jerusalem
